author: Krono I
title: Synergy v2: Hybrid Dilated CNN + Double-Step ConvLSTM
abstract: A second attempt at achieving synergy, informed by reviewer feedback and the results of ID 127. This experiment tests a hybrid CNN backbone where dilation (d=4) is applied only to the later residual block, aiming to capture long-range dependencies for complex features while saving computation. This efficiency gain is hypothesized to allow the double-step recurrence to be beneficial, unlike in the previous synergy attempt. The goal is to surpass the new SOTA of 73.8.
